context: Implementation only. The threat-model decision belongs to the ADR, and the safe non-policy optimizations belong to opt-audit-safe-optimizations.
description: Blocked behind opt-audit-open-policy-adr. Implements whichever option that record approves for what the audit chain guarantees at open. Today database.py:283 calls verify_audit() on every open in both credential modes, full-scanning events at 9738 rows and 4.7 MB per invocation on BenchBox. The candidate options are a head-only check, extending the replica to read-only commands so the full walk stays local, a persistent process, or signed checkpoints. Do not presume the head-only outcome: it cannot detect mid-chain modification of actor, action, detail, timestamp, or a same-sequence replacement, and that is a change to a documented product property.

anti_patterns.dont: Call the new check O(1) verification
anti_patterns.instead: Name and document it as a bounded-cost health check, with verify_audit as the integrity authority
anti_patterns.why: count(*) still scans in SQLite and the check cannot detect mid-chain tampering; the honest claim is constant network payload under a bounded corruption model

anti_patterns.dont: Present a head check as chain verification
anti_patterns.instead: instead name it a bounded-cost health check and keep verify_audit as the integrity authority
anti_patterns.why: count(*) still scans and the check cannot detect mid-chain tampering, so calling it verification overstates the guarantee

anti_patterns.dont: Ship the narrowing without the nightly full verify wired to a real target
anti_patterns.instead: Land w5 in the same change as w1, pointed at the production database, not a fresh CI one
anti_patterns.why: On-open full verification is the only thing currently walking the chain; removing it with no replacement leaves mid-chain tampering undetected indefinitely

preserves.behavior: Head tampering, truncation, and bogus appends are still caught at open
Signed export manifests keep verifying against the full chain
audit verify, export, and restore still perform the full chain walk
verify_audit returns algorithm, event_count, head_seq, head_hash

verifications.command: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .

README: state the resulting open-time guarantee precisely
